newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down slightly amid correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down slightly amid correction.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed slightly down on Monday on a correction of prices of some overpriced scrips, said brokers.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 12.98 points or 0.74 percent at 1,727.88 on a turnover of 121.2 million taka. Of 122 traded issues 54 gained and 65 lost.

"The market has now been stabilised after a few sessions' correction. Two leading scrips in cement and engineering sectors pushed the index down," said one broker. Leasing stock IDLC rose 121 taka to 5,033, Singer Bangladesh shed 18 to 12,891, Beximco Pharma rose 3.0 to 231 and Chittagong Cement fell 395 to 4,523.
